summary: Immuron Limited furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX public notice titled 'Travelan Phase 2 Study Results Published.' The disclosure concerns clinical data from a randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial of once-daily oral Travelan for prevention of travellers' diarrhoea, previously announced in March 2024, now published in Nature Scientific Reports. The study missed primary efficacy endpoints, though it showed a statistically significant 50% reduction in ETEC challenge-related adverse events versus placebo (P=0.0001), with a lower-than-anticipated 33% placebo attack rate reducing statistical power. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved; the event is an ordinary R&D milestone announcement.
